other_conditions: Girl child must be born on or after June 1, 2016
Girl child must be born in a government or private medical institution registered with Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
Only two girl children per family are eligible
Parents must have an Aadhar Card and a Bhamashah Card
benefits_summary: Financial support ranging from ₹2,500 at birth to ₹25,000 at 12th class admission for eligible girl children.
